reviews.text: They are honest, trustworthy and their prices left me eternally grateful. My son was in town and his car broke down. They were there so fast, I have never in my life seen a tow truck with such a rapid response... They did a great job and had his car running by the very next day.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: I previously had my car at a different auto shop for 6 months. I was able take it to Lyk-Nu. Even though they were fully booked, they made my car a priority and fixed it within two weeks! My car was in amazing condition when I got it back.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Best place around!! Will help you any way possible. Great body and paint work as well.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Had car trouble at I-75. Pulled off the interstate and called Lyk Nu... Bill the mechanic hooked his computer and diagnosed it. He had it fixed in about an hour for a reasonable price. We would give them 6 stars if we could.
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Great team of people here, excellent work! And pretty quick as well. Thank you for the quality work!
reviews.author: Google reviewer

reviews.text: Had to have our car towed to a dealer and our insurance sent Jacub to tow it. He did a great job and was very pleasant to chat with on the 30 minute drive. Very professional and considerate.
